name: focus01 -mai-
source:
The Mai from that summer... is not the cousin who I once knew...

The interwoven summer story of the protagonist and his younger cousin.
She was still innocent, he was entering his middle years.
To look on her blossoming youth stoked his instinctive fires...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE116629.html]DLsite English[/url]]
